laws.rule: Parks Victoria says recreational drone use by the public is not permitted on its managed land. Commercial drone filming requires permission and a fully licensed pilot and CASA-certified operator, including for drones under 2 kg.
laws.heading: Parks and outdoor access

laws.rule: Parks Victoria generally requires a permit for filming or photography undertaken as a trade or business; basic hobby or personal-use filming generally does not require one. Its published minimum processing time is 10 business days after complete documentation. Applications including drones need at least 20 business days.
laws.heading: Parks and outdoor access

laws.rule: In Victorian national and state parks, Parks Victoria says campfires may be lit only in park-provided purpose-built fireplaces where fires are allowed. No campfires or solid or chemical fuel barbecues are allowed on total fire ban days. Check local restrictions.
laws.heading: Parks and outdoor access

laws.rule: Parks Victoria says dogs are not allowed in most national parks, including beaches within them. Some regional parks allow dogs in designated areas; check the individual park and keep a permitted dog on a lead.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Parks Victoria asks visitors to learn about the Traditional Owners of the Country they are visiting, and to acknowledge and respect their continuing connection with Country. Stay on marked trails: off-trail walking might damage Aboriginal heritage sites.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Some Victorian rock art places are culturally sensitive or highly vulnerable and are not suitable to visit; others are open to the public. 92% of known rock art in the State is on the parks estate, with a high concentration in the Gariwerd cultural landscape (Grampians National Park).
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Parks Victoria, working with Traditional Owners.
culture-and-protocol.note: Visitor guidance from Parks Victoria's responsible-visiting page (19 April 2024) and its Aboriginal heritage page. Site-specific access is not listed in full here.
